name: Korea Digital Nomad Visa (F-1-D)
description: Official 2026 F-1-D rules for qualifying overseas remote workers and accompanying family.
tagline: Remote work for a qualifying overseas business or company
keyRequirement: Age, planned stay area, family accompaniment, same-industry experience and income determine eligibility.

eligibility.label: Age and family
eligibility.description: Main applicant must be 18+; legal spouse and unmarried minor children may accompany.

eligibility.label: Overseas remote work profile
eligibility.description: Overseas business owner or overseas-company affiliate able to work remotely, with at least one year in the same industry.

eligibility.label: 2026 income band
eligibility.description: ₩52.416M–₩104.832M based on age, stay area and accompanying family; confirm the application-date GNI table.

eligibility.label: Individual medical insurance
eligibility.description: At least ₩100M for treatment and repatriation during stay.

fees.extension: Confirm with the competent immigration office
fees.notes: The national fact sheet lists a fee but not a single nationwide amount.

incomeRequirement.notes: 2026 reference: age 18–34 capital 1.5× / qualifying regional 1×; age 35+ capital 2× / qualifying regional 1.5×; with spouse or minor child capital 2× / qualifying regional 1.5×. Base GNI ₩52.416M.
proofMethods: Employment certificate, pay slips and account transactions
Qualifying regional stay evidence: 1+ month lease or workation facility/accommodation reservation

insuranceRequirement.notes: Must cover treatment and repatriation during the stay.

documents.name: Core application documents
documents.description: Form No.17, passport, one photo and fee.

documents.name: Work and income proof
documents.description: Employment certificate plus proof such as pay slips and account transactions.

documents.name: Criminal record and insurance
documents.description: Criminal-record certificate with Apostille/consular legalization and insurance proof.

documents.name: Conditional evidence
documents.description: Family relationship evidence when accompanying family; qualifying-region stay evidence when using the reduced threshold.

applicationSteps.title: Apply or request status change
applicationSteps.description: Apply at the responsible Korean mission; B-1, B-2 and C-3 holders meeting the criteria may request change at a local immigration office.

processingTime.notes: No universal official processing-time promise used.

restrictions: Employment and profit-making activities are restricted
Not a general authorization for Korean employment or Korean-market freelancing
workPermission.notes: Ask immigration to assess a specific activity.

faqs.question: Can I change from short-term status in Korea?
faqs.answer: The Ministry says eligible B-1, B-2 and C-3 holders may request F-1-D change at a local immigration office.

tips: Confirm the GNI band and regional eligibility before committing to accommodation.
warnings: Do not rely on a single historic ₩88M threshold or a two-year maximum.
